 Korean actress Shin Min-a, celebrated for her acting and philanthropy, has grown from teen model to star of The Remarried Empress
 3 -MIN READ 3 -MIN Listen Pierce Conran in Seoul Published: 9:15pm, 14 Nov 2026 Shin Min-a currently rules the Eastern Empire as the titular character in Disney+’s hit fantasy romance The Remarried Empress . Yet, lofty though her protagonist’s rank may be, the actress is no stranger to being at the top, having enjoyed broad popularity since breaking out on screen more than a quarter of a century ago. Entering the industry as a model at age 14 in 1998, Shin quickly found herself in front of numerous cameras, appearing in a slew of popular music videos and advertisements.
 She became a minor sensation in the late 1990s, even before making her film debut in the cult hit Volcano High (2001) and her television debut alongside Lee Byung-hun in the classic romance Beautiful Days (2001) while still a teenager.
